text:
jamie: CI image push failing for PR #6122. kaniko upload step keeps returning 504 from our registry, failing the Docker publish stage. buildkite: https://buildkite.example.com/builds/9876

lucas: hmm, 504 usually a transient registry backend timeout. can you paste the kaniko log snippet?

sophie: reran once and it failed again, so not purely transient. PR did change the Dockerfile to add another build stage and changed layer ordering. suspect larger blob upload size.

marco: 504 on PUT/PATCH often means the storage backend (S3) timed out or our nginx proxy closed the upstream. share the exact error lines.

jamie: log snippet:
```
INFO[0012] Uploading blob "sha256:abcd1234..." to https://registry.redwood.local/v2/repo/image/blobs/uploads/
WARN[0020] upload failed: server response: 504 Gateway Timeout
error: http status 504 while uploading blob
```

lucas: quick try: bump kaniko retries and force single-threaded uploads. add `--retries=6` and `--single-threaded` to the kaniko flags. also try `--cache-repo` off to force clean upload if cache corrupt.

marco: on infra side I just increased `proxy_read_timeout` to 120s on the registry nginx and lowered `max_upload_concurrency` on the blobstore to 2 to reduce contention. will monitor.

sophie: i applied `--retries=6 --single-threaded --cache=false` locally against the registry and push succeeded. looks like a retry/backpressure issue.

jamie: rerunning CI with those flags now (triggering rebuild so it will create a new image id).

infra-bot: Buildkite: re-run triggered for build #9876 by jamie — https://buildkite.example.com/builds/9876

olive: nice, keep us posted. :thumbsup:

marco: opened INF-3214 to add exponential backoff + throttling on registry proxy and to audit S3 timeouts. short-term patch will be docs + CI flag defaults.

lucas: moral: recent Dockerfile change increased size of a single layer; consider splitting large assets into smaller layers or using multi-upload chunking.

jamie: CI rerun passed, merging PR. will follow up with a note in the PR and link to INF-3214. thanks all. :rocket:
